caption:
Iced Vietnamese Coconut Coffee | Cà Phê Cốt Dừa

Transport yourself to the bustling streets of Vietnam with the invigorating taste of Vietnamese iced coconut coffee. This refreshing beverage is a symphony of flavors, blending the rich aroma of Vietnamese coffee with the sweetness of condensed milk and the delicate creaminess of coconut milk.

C: 6 | F: 3 | P: 1
Calories: 57 per serving
Makes 2 medium glasses or 1 large serving 

Ingredients
coffee mix: 
2 tbsp vietnamese coffee
1/2 cup boiling water
OR 
2 shots espresso 

coconut slushy 
3 tbsp coconut milk
2 tbsp hot water
2  tsp condensed milk
1 1/2 cup ice

Method 
brew the coffee in the phin or make the espresso ( i cool the coffee before using as it will melt the slushy immediately ) 
in a blender, add in coconut milk + hot water + condensed milk + ice and blend together at high speed to form the coconut slush ( it will be snow like and fluffy ) 
in a glass, add on the coffee and then the coconut and serve immediately
